title: Newborn Special Pass
summary: Baby born in Singapore while you hold an EP — ICA Special Pass clock, birth certificate / passport sequence, Dependant Pass or LTVP filing, and what not to confuse with family-joining flights from abroad.

sections.title: Hospital week: papers before the pass clock
sections.body: A Singapore birth triggers registry and passport work before MOM will treat the child as a dependant on your EP. Get the birth certificate path clear with the hospital / ICA registry instructions, then decide which travel document the child will use (home-country passport vs other). Do not wait for a “perfect” passport photo appointment before you understand the Special Pass window.
bullets: Collect discharge paperwork and registry instructions before you leave the ward
Confirm which parent’s nationality will issue the first passport
Keep both parents’ FIN / EP details ready for every form

sections.title: ICA Special Pass is a filing buffer, not a lifestyle pass
sections.body: Babies born here commonly receive a short ICA Special Pass so they remain lawful while you gather documents and file for a longer stay (often Dependant Pass via the employer). The Special Pass is time-boxed — treat the expiry as a hard project deadline, not a soft reminder. Overstaying while “waiting on the embassy” is still an overstay.
bullets: Diary the Special Pass expiry the day it is issued
Start employer DP paperwork in parallel with passport processing
If documents slip, ask ICA / MOM paths early — do not improvise at the counter on expiry day

sections.title: Dependant Pass vs longer visit options
sections.body: Most EP households file a Dependant Pass for the newborn through the sponsoring employer once documents exist. Some families explore longer visit arrangements when DP eligibility is unclear — that is a different legal track from the Special Pass. Align with HR early: DP issuance still needs IPA discipline and medicals when MOM requires them.
bullets: Ask HR which dependant product they will sponsor and typical turnaround
Sketch IPA enter-and-issue dates on /tools/ipa-window once an IPA exists
Do not book non-refundable newborn travel on folklore timelines

sections.title: This is not the same as family joining later
sections.body: Family-joining playbooks cover spouse/kids flying in on approved IPAs. A newborn Special Pass case starts inside Singapore with a local birth and a short ICA buffer. Reuse Arrival Card and Singpass lessons only where they apply — the baby’s first lawful stay is already onshore.
bullets: Use /journeys/family-joining for inbound dependants still abroad
Use this playbook when the child was born here and needs a next pass
Do not assume SG Arrival Card folklore replaces Special Pass / DP steps

sections.title: Insurance, mobile OTP, and cash float
sections.body: Hospital bills, paediatric follow-ups, and passport fees hit while your own Singpass OTP still depends on a working +65 number. Keep one Singapore mobile alive for MOM / bank / Singpass SMS through DP issuance. Sketch leave-related SIM keep-vs-port costs early if a parent’s exit is also in play.
bullets: Confirm newborn coverage start dates on any Integrated Shield / rider
Keep OTP SMS reachable until DP card / FIN workflows finish
Sketch SIM keep vs port cash on /tools/sim-otp-keep

sections.title: If you must leave before DP issuance
sections.body: Leaving Singapore with a newborn still on Special Pass — or mid-DP issuance — needs explicit confirmation of re-entry rules. Do not assume a cancelled parent EP plus a baby Special Pass will both survive a family emergency flight. Sequence parent cancel / IR21 / baby paperwork with counsel or HR before anyone boards.
bullets: Ask ICA / MOM whether the child’s current pass allows exit and return
Never treat parent Singpass login grace as the baby’s immigration status
Carry originals and certified copies in hand luggage
